export const GPT_IMAGE_MODELS = ["gpt-image-1", "gpt-image-2"] as const

export type GptImageModelId = (typeof GPT_IMAGE_MODELS)[number]

export const isGptImageModel = (model: unknown): model is GptImageModelId =>
	typeof model === "string" &&
	GPT_IMAGE_MODELS.includes(model as GptImageModelId)
